description: Forget what sci-fi has told you about superintelligent robots that are uncannily human-like; the reality is more prosaic. Inside DeepMind’s robotics laboratory, Hannah explores what researchers call ‘embodied AI’: robot arms that are learning tasks like picking up plastic bricks, which humans find comparatively easy. Discover the cutting-edge challenges of bringing AI and robotics together, and learning from scratch how to perform tasks. She also explores some of the key questions about using AI…
classificationReason: Explicitly focuses on embodied AI, robot-arm manipulation learning, real-world deployment, and AI safety.
qualityReason: Focused explanatory episode with researchers and concrete discussion of robotics research challenges.
